wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/size_conflicts.sh: #!/bin/zsh
# Counts conflict hunks per unmerged file, generated builtin docs excluded: those are resolved by
# REGENERATING, not by reading, so counting them would drown the files that need judgement.
cd /Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature || exit 1
git status --short \
  | grep "^UU" \
  | sed 's/^.. //' \
  | grep -v 'docs/internals/builtins/\|docs/php/builtins' \
  | while read -r f; do
      n=$(grep -c '^<<<<<<<' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
      [[ -z "$n" ]] && n=0
      printf '%3d %s\n' "$n" "$f"
    done | sort -rn
